headline: Pafos, beaten 1-3 by Atalanta, host Riga and chase a first win
summary: Pafos lost 1-3 at Atalanta in their Conference League opener and sit 32nd in the table with 0 points. Atalanta created 3.47 expected goals, so the score was fair. Cypriot media say Pafos want their first league phase win tonight. Riga arrive in better form, with 4 wins in their last 5 games, and a Spanish preview says they have scored in each of their last 10 matches. Even so, the market makes Pafos favourites, with a fair chance of 59.5%, up 2.4 points in recent days. It expects about 2.71 goals.
read: Pafos are 59.5% favourites at home after the market backed them a little more in recent days, but they have no points and conceded far better chances in a 1-3 defeat at Atalanta. Riga bring a scoring run of 10 matches and good recent form, so goals at both ends are a real possibility.

facts.fact: Pafos have no points after their opening league phase game and Cypriot media say they want their first win tonight.
facts.meaning: Pafos start the night under pressure to open their account.

facts.fact: At Atalanta, Pafos created 0.91 expected goals and allowed 3.47.
facts.meaning: The 1-3 defeat was not a fluke; Atalanta had far better chances.

facts.fact: Riga arrive with four wins and one draw in their last five games.
facts.meaning: Riga travel in good form, even if most of those games were in the Latvian league.

facts.fact: Riga have scored in each of their last 10 matches in all competitions, according to a Spanish preview.
facts.meaning: Pafos will find it hard to keep a clean sheet.

facts.fact: Riga created 2.45 expected goals per game in their last five matches.
facts.meaning: Riga make chances at a high rate, though against weaker league opponents.

facts.fact: The market makes Pafos clear favourites, with a 59.5% chance to win.
facts.meaning: More likely than not that Pafos win, far ahead of Riga's chance.

facts.fact: Pafos's winning chance rose by 2.4 points in recent days.
facts.meaning: The market has become a little more confident in the home side.

facts.fact: Pafos drew 0-0 at home with Apoel Nicosia on Monday, three days before this game.
facts.meaning: They have a goalless league game behind them and only three days of rest.

sources.fact: Pafos have no points after the first league phase round, where they lost 3-1 to Atalanta.
Cypriot media say Pafos want their first league phase win of the Conference League tonight.
Cypriot media report that around 4,000 Pafos fans are travelling to Limassol, where the match is played at the Alphamega stadium.
Latvian media say Riga keep collecting points in the Conference League and visit the Cypriot club in their second league phase match.
